checks.candidate_load: get_last_callable(source.read_text(), path=str(source)); source selected from frozen OUT/package/{agents/mgt_m1.py,agents/mgt_y3.py,main.py}; pkg appended to sys.path and v9lite root discovery scans sys.path in reverse
checks.input_boundary: candidate invoked with deepcopy of its current observation plus its own remainingOverageTime; no seed or future-shop specification passed; opponent receives its own observation/private state
checks.shop_schedule: persisted eight-shop worlds; empty at step0; sequence prefix unlocked at end of days 3,6,...,24 and asserted before each policy call; future shops are not passed to policy; V9 rollout forecasts draw independently from scenario RNG given only currently visible shops
checks.engine_hook_isolation: real-game ledger uses outer research Simulator hooks on the imported engine; V9 rollout isolated_engine() execs official engine source into a distinct ModuleType and restores its own _commit_unit/_apply_unit_action/_do_hire hooks in finally
checks.ledger: research Simulator records only successful commits plus successful HIRE/BUY_LAND cash movements; driver asserts initial 3000 + revenue - spend equals final cash for both seats
checks.time: candidate get_last_callable source-evaluation/load duration is added to first policy-call duration; bank subtracts max(0,elapsed-1s), fails below zero; rival wall time is not counted in candidate bank
checks.pairing: 64 persisted distinct seeds; 2 opponents crossed per world; 3 arms each launched as a fresh subprocess; each world uses seat i%2, yielding 32 worlds per seat within each opponent; arm rows are paired on same world/opponent/seat
checks.archive: driver verifies source archive digest against package manifest, validates all frozen package files against manifest, copies verified package and archive to output once, then checks frozen package files and archive digest
checks.entrypoint: v9lite_agent is final callable in frozen main.py, consistent with get_last_callable
